data.name: Deluxe Pedal Kayak Tour | Marco Island and Naples, Florida
data.headline: 5+ years old • 2 Hours • Explore Marco Island’s natural beauty!
data.description:
#Explore Marco Island’s natural beauty without getting tired!

##Duration
2 Hours

We will reach out to you for the exact start time and meeting time.

##About
Want to explore Marco Island’s natural beauty without getting tired? Our pedal kayaking eco-tours are perfect for you! Glide through the mangroves and wildlife effortlessly, and take in the stunning views without any distractions.

Our eco-tours are designed to be relaxing and enjoyable, providing a unique way to connect with nature. We will take you on a journey through the island’s hidden gems, giving you fascinating insights into the local ecosystem.

##Included
- First-class pedal kayaks
- Life vests
- Safety gear for a worry-free adventure

##Not Included
- Gratuities 
- Parking fee approximately $10

##What to bring
- Casual
- Comfortable athletic clothing
- Hat and light jacket
- Water shoes
- Long sleeves
- Sunblock
data.cancellation_notes: Customers will receive a full refund or credit with 48 hours notice of cancellation. Customers will also receive a full refund or credit in case of operator cancellation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances. Contact us by phone to cancel or inquire about a cancellation. No-shows will be charged the full price.
data.booking_notes:
We appreciate you very much for making your reservation with us!

**We share a dream**
We are three adventurers who are lifelong friends fulfilling our dreams by creating eco-adventures for you. When we are not leading you on eco-safaris and island tours, we are seeking out new routes, researching new animal species, listening to uplifting books, meditating, and laughing. When you tour with us, you don’t just get back on land with wonderful nature pictures and magical memories, but you connect with a part of your own abundant spirit; a love of life, the planet, and that you can find a positive vibration no matter what life throws your way.

##What to bring
- Casual
- Comfortable athletic clothing
- Hat and light jacket
- Water shoes
- Long sleeves
- Sunblock
